design: Same core96/rank32/native coefficients/seeds/minibatches/4 runs/400 updates as H296. Each sample squared error divided by its actual or angle training-family mean target energy; uniform joint sampling yields equal expected family weight. Validation selects maximum minimum(actual,angle) fidelity. Step0 proxy retained. Changes BOTH objective normalization and selection rule; comparison not pure objective-only causal isolation.

gates.balanced_gain: optimized vs proxy>=5pp cross fidelity with paired95 lower>0 actual AND angle
gates.retention: optimized vs proxy paired95 lower>=-1pp both
gates.pooled_tradeoff_repair: optimized vs H296 actual gain>=2pp with positive lower95 AND angle lower95 gain>=-1pp

scope: Nonconvex finite-budget; no global optimum. Fixed rank/cost. Reused diagnostic panel. Selection value named validation_fidelity is WORST-family, audits train/validation remain pooled. No intact eval.
